hypothesis_claim: Appending exactly this one system-prompt instruction—"Before broad verification of a multi-module Python change, identify the most plausible silent contract violation at a changed module boundary, run the cheapest check capable of falsifying that contract first, then use only the remaining pre-deadline verification budget on broader checks."—will, versus no appended instruction with all other conditions fixed, reduce regression_count without increasing deadline misses; pass_rate, tool_calls, wall_time, and cost will be measured to determine whether the tradeoff is favorable.
baseline_description: Agent defaults: identical prompt, model, tools, and limits with no appended system prompt.
intervention: Before broad verification of a multi-module Python change, identify the most plausible silent contract violation at a changed module boundary, run the cheapest check capable of falsifying that contract first, then use only the remaining pre-deadline verification budget on broader checks.
